test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: The aim of the Civil Disobedience Movement of 1929 was

options.text: Complete disobedience of the orders of the British Government.
Partial disobedience of the orders of the British Government.
To ensure all civil rights of the citizens are granted by the Government.

solution: On March 12, 1930, Indian independence leader Mohandas Gandhi begins a defiant march to the sea in protest of the British monopoly on salt, his boldest act ofcivil disobedience yet against British rule in India.
